confirmedFindings.title: Non-atomic ETS lookup-then-insert creates race condition under concurrent access
confirmedFindings.body: Using :ets.lookup followed by :ets.insert introduces a race condition under concurrent access. Use :ets.update_counter/4 for atomic counter increments.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Replace separate lookup and insert with :ets.update_counter(@table, tenant_id, {2, 1}, {tenant_id, 0}).
